commands.calc.help.command.config: /calc config [default|power-order]: manage result presentation; omit the subcommand to show current settings
commands.calc.help.command.numfmt: /calc numfmt [default|able|disable|scope|format|template]: manage number formatting; omit the subcommand to show current settings
commands.calc.help.command.solve: /calc solve <equations> <variables>: solve real equations or systems
commands.calc.help.config.power_order: Polynomial order: /calc config power-order [ascending|descending|default]; omit the argument to show the current value. The default is ascending.
commands.calc.help.detail.config.descrip: Configure result presentation without changing evaluated values or ans.
commands.calc.help.detail.config.params:
- <setting>: default or power-order.
       - <value>: ascending, descending, or default; omit it to show the current value.
commands.calc.help.detail.diff.descripti: Differentiate a function in the supplied variable order.
commands.calc.help.detail.diff.params:
- <function>: Function to differentiate.
       - <variables>: Differentiation variables; commas apply successive higher or mixed derivatives.
commands.calc.help.detail.expand.descrip: Expand products or powers in a symbolic expression.
commands.calc.help.detail.expression.des: Evaluate a calculator expression and save the last successful result to ans.
commands.calc.help.detail.expression.par: - <expression>: Mathematical expression using numbers, constants, functions, operators, and ans.
commands.calc.help.detail.integrate.desc: Evaluate a definite integral between the supplied limits.
commands.calc.help.detail.integrate.para:
- <integrand>: Function being integrated.
       - <variable>: Variable of integration.
       - <lower-limit>: Lower integration limit.
       - <upper-limit>: Upper integration limit.
commands.calc.help.detail.numfmt.descrip: Configure inventory-style box, stack, and remainder formatting.
commands.calc.help.detail.numfmt.params:
- <subcommand>: default, able, disable, scope, format, or template.
       - <value>: Value for the selected subcommand; omit it to show the current value.
commands.calc.help.detail.solve.descript: Solve one equation or a system over the real numbers.
commands.calc.help.detail.solve.params:
- <equations>: Equations separated with semicolons.
       - <variables>: Unknowns separated with commas.
commands.calc.help.footer: Use /calc help [command] to view details for a specific command.
commands.calc.help.functions: Functions: %s. ln(x): natural log; lg(x): base 10; log2(x): base 2; log(base, x): given base. n(x, digits): decimal approximation. ans preserves the last successful result exactly.
commands.calc.help.numfmt.format: Value type: /calc numfmt format [integer|double|all|default]; omit the argument to show the current value. The default is integer.
commands.calc.help.numfmt.scope: Scope: /calc numfmt scope [default|show|<add|remove> <expression|factor|integrate|solve>]; omit the argument to show the current value.
commands.calc.help.numfmt.template: Template: /calc numfmt template [default|<template> [--stack <size>]]; omit the argument to show the current value. Press Tab for presets; every { must be paired as {}.
commands.calc.help.symbolic_variables: Separate equations with semicolons and variables with commas (no spaces). diff x,y differentiates successively; x,x gives the second derivative. solve uses real solutions. Bounds may be expressions; wrap bounds containing spaces in parentheses.
